# Cloudisoft

> Cloudisoft (Cloudisoft LLC) builds websites, workflow automations, CRM systems, AI voice agents and secure cloud infrastructure for growing businesses in the United States and India. Offices in Hillside, New Jersey and Ahmedabad, Gujarat.

Tagline: Automate Intelligence. Amplify Growth.

## Services and starting prices (USD, not final quotes)

- Websites — from $200: landing pages, business websites and web apps; design, SEO and analytics setup, forms, booking and payments, hosting and SSL.
- Automations — from $750: workflow mapping, API and webhook integrations, AI document and email handling, monitoring and alerts.
- CRM setup — quoted with automations: pipeline design, data import and clean-up, lead routing and follow-ups, reports and dashboards.
- AI voice agents — from $1,000: inbound and outbound calling, calendar and CRM booking, human handoff, transcripts and QA, in English, Hindi and nine more Indian languages.
- Cloud infrastructure, security and SOC 2 compliance readiness — from $1,500: cloud build or migration, identity and access, backups, hardening and monitoring, security policies and audit evidence.

Final pricing depends on scope; Cloudisoft sends a fixed quote before work begins.

## Products

- [CloudiVoice](https://cloudivoice.cloudisoft.com/): AI voice agents that answer calls, qualify leads, book appointments, screen candidates and hand off to a human.
- [ApplyFlux](https://applyflux.cloudisoft.com/): Upload a resume once; ApplyFlux finds matching roles, fills and tracks applications, and pauses whenever a human decision is needed.
